sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

The present appeal is filed by the appellant/claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 17.10.2012 in MVC.No.429/2012 passed by the Presiding Officer, FTC.IV and Additional MACT,
Mysore, for seeking enhancement of the compensation.
2. The factum of accident is not in dispute.

3. Heard the arguments from both sides and perused the records.
4.

The Tribunal has awarded global compensation of Rs.4,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6%
per annum from the date of petition till the date of deposit.

5. From the medical evidence on record, it is proved that the claimant had sustained the following injuries:
a. Cut wound over eyebrow b.
Pain and tenderness present over right shoulder restricted movements with tenderness, c. Fracture over right clavicle d.
Cut wound over right lateral mallelous e.
Cut wound over dorsum 6.
The evidence on record proves that the claimant had made expenditure of Rs.29,000/-, but the same is not granted.
Therefore, compensation of Rs.29,000/- is awarded under the head medical expenses.
7. Further compensation of Rs.20,000/- is awarded under the head injury, pain and suffering considering the nature of injury sustained.

9. Further compensation of Rs.10,000/- is awarded under the head incidental expenses like food,
nourishment, conveyance and attendant charges etc.,
10.

Thus, in all the appellant/claimant is entitled to total compensation determined by this Court as follows:
1 Injury, pain and suffering Rs. 20,000/-

nourishment, conveyance and attendant charges etc., Rs.
11 . The Tribunal has awarded global compensation of Rs.4,000/-, but the appellant/claimant is entitled to total compensation of Rs.89,000/-.
Hence, the appellant/claimant is entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.85,000/- (Rs.89,000/- - Rs.4,000/-).
Therefore, the appellant/claimant is entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.85,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of deposit.

12. Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i.
The appeal is allowed-in-part.

ii. The impugned judgment and award dated 17.10.2012 in MVC.No.429/2012 passed by the Presiding Officer, FTC.IV and Additional MACT, Mysore, is modified to the extent that the appellant/claimant is entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.85,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of deposit.
iii. No order as to costs.
iv. Registry is directed to transmit the TCR along with copy of this order to the Tribunal forthwith.
